Privacy Policy

Last updated: 12 August 2026.

This policy explains how HEGEVA AI handles personal information when you create an account or use the workspace.

Information we may process

  • Account information such as name, email address and authentication/session data.
  • Business profile information you choose to save, such as business name, address, company number and VAT number.
  • Workspace information you enter, including customer details, documents, expenses, planner items, notes and saved AI chats.
  • AI messages and business context that you choose to send to the HEGEVA AI backend.
  • Technical/security information necessary to operate the service, such as session, request and error information.

Why we use information

  • To create and maintain your account and authenticated workspace.
  • To provide features you request, including cloud workspace sync and AI responses.
  • To protect the service, prevent abuse, enforce usage limits and diagnose faults.
  • To respond to support, privacy and account requests.

Local browser storage and essential session technology

HEGEVA uses browser storage for supported local workspace features. Signed-in features may also use essential authentication/session technology so the service can keep you signed in and protect account access. Non-essential advertising or analytics cookies are not enabled by this build.

AI processing

When you send a message to HEGEVA AI, the message, selected language, recent chat context and any business context you provide may be sent to the secure backend and its AI infrastructure solely to generate the requested response and operate usage controls. Do not enter information you are not authorised to process.

Customer data you enter

If you enter information about your own customers or contacts, you are responsible for having an appropriate reason and lawful basis to use that information. HEGEVA provides workspace tools; it does not determine whether your customer data collection is lawful.

Data sharing

Information may be processed by infrastructure or AI service providers used to operate HEGEVA, and may be disclosed where required by law or necessary to protect the service. A production launch should maintain an up-to-date list of material service providers and international transfer safeguards where applicable.

Retention

Workspace data is retained for as long as needed to provide the account/service or until it is deleted, subject to security, backup and legal retention needs. Local browser copies remain on the device until cleared by the user or browser.

Your rights

Depending on applicable data-protection law, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or objection, and to complain to the relevant data-protection regulator. Contact HEGEVA using the support email shown above.

Security

HEGEVA uses authenticated backend routes for account, cloud and AI functions. No online system can guarantee absolute security. Protect your password and do not share credentials or secret keys through workspace fields or support messages.

Changes

This policy may be updated when HEGEVA adds new processing, payment providers, analytics, integrations or other material functionality. Material changes should be communicated appropriately before they take effect.

Terms of Service

Last updated: 12 August 2026.

1. Service

HEGEVA AI provides business productivity tools including AI assistance, CRM, document creation, expense tracking, planning, reports and supported cloud workspace functions. Features may change as the service develops.

2. No professional advice

HEGEVA AI is not a solicitor, accountant, tax adviser, financial adviser or regulated financial service. AI and workspace outputs are informational and administrative assistance. You remain responsible for checking legal, tax, VAT, accounting, payment and customer-facing information before relying on or sending it.

3. Accounts

You are responsible for providing accurate registration information, protecting your login credentials and activity carried out through your account. Do not share passwords or attempt to access another user’s workspace.

4. Your content and customer information

You retain responsibility for information you enter into HEGEVA. You must have the rights and permissions needed to use and process that information, including personal information relating to customers or other individuals.

5. AI output

AI-generated content can be incomplete or incorrect. HEGEVA does not guarantee that AI output is accurate, legally compliant, tax-compliant or suitable for a particular purpose. Important decisions and customer documents should be checked by a qualified person where appropriate.

6. Acceptable use

You must not misuse the service, attempt unauthorised access, interfere with security or usage controls, upload unlawful content, use the service to violate another person’s rights, or use HEGEVA in a way prohibited by applicable law.

7. Availability and changes

Cloud, network and AI-provider availability can affect parts of the service. HEGEVA may maintain, modify or temporarily suspend functionality for security, reliability or product changes. Local-only features may continue to work when the network is unavailable.

8. Plans and payment status

In this build, payment processing is disabled. Premium or Pro access must not be treated as purchased unless a future payment system and the backend both confirm the entitlement. Before paid subscriptions are enabled, HEGEVA must clearly show the price, taxes where applicable, billing period, renewal/cancellation terms and any applicable cancellation/refund rights before the user pays.

9. Cancellation and refunds

Because paid checkout is not enabled in this build, no paid subscription cancellation or refund process is currently active. When paid subscriptions are introduced, the checkout and confirmation flow must state the applicable cancellation rights and refund rules and provide the required contract information in a form the customer can keep.

10. Liability

Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot legally be excluded. Subject to applicable law, HEGEVA is not intended to replace professional verification of business, legal, tax, VAT, financial or accounting matters.

11. Ending access

You may stop using the service at any time. HEGEVA may restrict or suspend access where reasonably necessary for security, abuse prevention, legal compliance or serious breach of these terms.

12. Governing terms

The final governing-law and jurisdiction wording should match the legal entity operating HEGEVA and the markets in which it is offered. Complete the operator details before public launch and obtain professional legal review if selling subscriptions to consumers or internationally.

Cookie & Device Storage Notice

This V29.0 build uses local browser storage for workspace functionality and may use essential authentication/session technology for signed-in account security. It does not intentionally enable advertising or non-essential analytics cookies.

If analytics, advertising, tracking pixels or other non-essential storage technologies are added later, HEGEVA must update this notice and implement appropriate consent controls before those technologies run where consent is required.
